why: 「we may expend significant resources and time to qualify our products」＝費用と時間を負うのは当社。向きが逆
「initial terms ... generally five to seven years」＝複数年の契約期間を断定。顧客側の再認定の記述はなし
「require customers to invest heavily in certification and qualification」＋「switching costs for customers」＝顧客が費用と時間を負うと断定
「We strive to ... to design in our materials」＝願望形のみ。乗り換えの費用に触れていない
「listed by recognized building standards agencies」は当社が受ける認証。「specified by architects」だけで乗り換え費用なし
「switching ... is a significant undertaking」「conversion costs」「business disruption」を顧客が負う。再認定ではなく移行費用
「customers require a thorough review or qualification」「several months」と機構は名指しだが、乗り換え時の費用の帰属がない
「difficult for us to win new customers」＝競合の installed base で損をするのは当社。向きが逆
「extensive qualification process and potential redesign」は顧客側だが「may be reluctant」で断定でない
「licenses under a number of our patents」＝当社が持つ特許。乗り換えの費用の機構を名指ししていない
「significant capital equipment investment for our customers」＋「customers consume our ... instrument」＝据付装置の上に反復購入
「deeply embedded in many portions of financial advisors' daily workflow」＝組込を名指し。費用の記述はなし
「must also be certified by our individual OEM customers」は断定だが、後半「revoked or suspended ... prohibited」＝損は当社
「qualified for the application by the OEM, the U.S. Department of Defense, the FAA」だが「achieved ... after years」は当社の負担
「qualification process」は「the owner's reviews of the purchaser」＝買い手の審査で、顧客の乗り換え費用ではない
「contracts which range from one to five years」＋turnoverなし。ただし「contract to provide this data」＝供給側
「designed for a specific customer」「sold only to that customer」だけで、乗り換えの費用も再認定も述べていない
「incorporated ... at the design stage」だが「require us to expend significant research and development」＝当社が負う
「a significant barrier to entry because a competitor would need to」＝新規参入者の障壁で、顧客の移行費用ではない
「Once ... designed into a given OEM customer's product」「barriers to subsequent supplier changes」＝設計組込を断定
「customers' prior investments in software development」＝顧客の先行投資だが「competitive factor」のみで向き不明
「initial non-cancellable term of at least ten years」「multiple renewal terms」＝解約不能の複数年義務を断定
「terms of three to five years」「high contract renewal rates」「non-discretionary」＝複数年義務。更新率は実数なし
「willingness to replace their currently deployed software solutions」の断片のみで、費用も機構も述べていない
「rigorous manufacturer certification」は当社が受ける認証、「difficult for new entrants」＝参入障壁で移行費用ではない
「high conversion costs can create barriers to adoption」で移行費用を名指し。ただし「can」の限定つきで向きも不明
「assist customers in designing, testing and qualifying our parts」＝当社が手伝う側で、顧客が費用を負うと述べていない
